description: This file contains functions for upgrading a Zyxel device firmware, including retrieving the root filesystem device, flashing the firmware, and performing the upgrade process, with specific handling for different device configurations.

methods.name: zyxel_get_rootfs
methods.description: Reads kernel command line parameters to determine the root filesystem device.

methods.name: zyxel_do_flash
methods.description: Handles flashing kernel and root filesystem, setting up loop devices, and preparing the device for new firmware.

methods.name: zyxel_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that determines device configuration and invokes flashing and upgrade routines.
